column1: # Standalone rule (2026-10-31), lineage decision (2026-11-10): sealed or hash-pinned lineage files whose donor
# references are data, not dependencies. check_standalone.py reports their D_REPO_REF lines as L_SEALED only while
# the file is byte-identical to the blob below and has no network capability; edit one and its lines count again
# (re-review, then re-pin or fix). Never list a file that checks out, fetches from or builds against another repository.
